name: [Equip] An edit has been waiting on translation too long
message:
Edits a teacher has made are held back because some language cannot be produced. They are invisible to students until every language has them, so a long hold is a correction nobody can see.

Previously this searched for an INFO line containing the word "blocked" — which never reaches the index (INFO is dropped) and which a perfectly healthy promotion also emits, as `blocked=0`. Wrong on both sides. It now watches a WARNING logged only when something is actually held.

Runbook: GET /api/v1/admin/translations/queue-status, then the course's translation progress panel to see which field and language is stuck.
